_why: Anchor-provided cancel link: the first matching anchor ('Manage your plan') is http and must be skipped; 'Pricing' does not match; 'Billing' (https) wins at 0.95. Notion has cancelURL null in the DB, so only the anchor can supply it. 'no charge until' is not a cue -> trialEnd = today + 1 calendar month. '$12' -> canonical '12' (no invented decimals).
